answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the terrace of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the pulse of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
